title: 首批三名当前默认外观与静态动作选择绑定
proof_scope: Static source default-skin/mode/action selection and an explicitly selected relative original-animation segment. No running client callback, first strike, activation, collision or end phase is asserted.

Current ability GetAnimKey uses default/down/up keys; current UnitAnimator obtains mode hooker and applies its actual replace/exclusion entries.
Silverash S3 raw Attack is hooked to Skill_3_Combat; Kaltsit transporting mode2 excludes its skill3 body animation and is not bound by this group.

Current defaultskin.prefab root -> uniquely hash-bound CharacterAnimator -> explicit Front/Back SkeletonAnimation -> SkeletonDataAsset -> binary TextAsset. All6 script SHA256 match their same-orientation pinned048 sources.
Current Unit vslot103=PlayAnimation and animated body vslot109=GetAnimKey establish the actual source dispatch; configured animation data is selected through current SpineAnimator.GetAnimationData.

SpineAnimator._OnEvent handles the OnAttack/OnAttackFinished names; EasyToStart waits for entity events and fixed-time fallback. These facts alone do not establish the frame phase.

SpineAnimator._TickSpineManually accumulates fixed-point delta and branches on RemoteConfig.spineTickInAdditionalFrame plus BattleController.isAdditionalFrame; SkeletonAnimation.Update then updates/applies AnimationState.
Raw OnAttack floats and the048 normalization/strict-ceil difference are retained. Preview frames are solely the already disclosed relative animation reference, never a measured callback frame.

Reports and stream descriptors distinguish static_selection_verified from runtime_binding_verified=false; actual_callback_frames, actual_activation_phase_seconds and actual_end_seconds remain null.
Changed skeleton identity/config cannot inherit the proof; returned rows and binding metadata are independently copied.
limits: Not a full client event scheduler; no client phase/FP accumulation/remote-config/hotfix assumptions added.
Defaultskin and listed static modes only; current live skin, caller mode/branch eligibility, XLua, attack/collision snapshots and runtime activation/end remain unverified.
Kaltsit normal/S1 ThreePartOneshotAnimation and Silverash ordinary A/B/C sequence retain their prior unresolved selection/lifecycle scope.
Unmapped operators retain their existing explicit reference choices. Source proof does not change any no-reference numeric default.
S2 manual duration stays a user condition and does not locate shield breaks or exhaustion; capacity/reload and actual end remain independent unknowns.
Necessary actual Windows selection-window verification is for root after serial integration; this agent did not open a live UI, game or chat.
